Qdrant can handle datasets ranging from 1 million to 100 million vectors while maintaining low latency.
ledger.quote: Scaling: Easily handles 1 million to 100 million vectors with consistent low latency.

ledger.text: Qdrant provides sub‑5 ms metadata filtering speeds before performing vector search.
ledger.quote: Filtering: Qdrant is famous for its sub-5ms metadata filtering speeds. It processes payload filters efficiently before doing the vector search.

ledger.text: Weaviate natively combines dense vector search with BM25 keyword search, offering best‑in‑class hybrid search for RAG.
ledger.quote: Hybrid Search: Best in class. Weaviate natively combines dense vector search with BM25 keyword search, making it ideal for document‑heavy RAG systems.
ledger.verdict_note: The counter‑evidence confirms that Weaviate’s hybrid search uses both BM25 keyword search and dense vector search, which aligns with the claim rather than contradicting it. (source: https://weaviate.io/blog/hybrid-search-explained)

ledger.text: Milvus is designed for massive enterprise workloads, scaling from 100 million up to over a billion vectors.
ledger.quote: Scaling: Built for 100 million to over a billion vectors and handles massive throughput.

ledger.text: Milvus requires heavy hardware and benefits strongly from GPU acceleration in large‑scale deployments.
ledger.quote: Hardware Needs: Heavy. Milvus requires robust clusters and strongly benefits from GPU acceleration to process massive batches of vectors.

ledger.text: Milvus has the largest community in the vector database category with over 42,000 GitHub stars.
ledger.quote: Milvus is the most widely adopted open-source vector database, with the largest community in the category (42,000+ stars on the Milvus GitHub repository)

ledger.text: Weaviate offers both self‑hosted and managed cloud deployment options and provides native hybrid search and multi‑tenant capabilities.
ledger.quote: Weaviate is the open-source, AI-native option: native hybrid search that blends vector and keyword scoring, vectorization modules that embed on write, GraphQL and REST APIs, and multi-tenancy with real data isolation. Self‑host it when data residency or on‑premises deployment is a requirement, or take the managed cloud when you would rather not tune it yourself.

ledger.text: Milvus requires engineering resources for deployment
ledger.quote: Milvus / Zilliz Cloud: billions of vectors at lower cost; requires engineering resources.
Weaviate: hybrid search (vector + BM25 + metadata filters) with strong docs and modular embeddings.

ledger.text: Qdrant is suitable for budget-conscious teams and offers a generous free tier
ledger.quote: Qdrant: budget-conscious teams, best free tier, native sparse (SPLADE, miniCOIL) and ColBERT multi-vector support.
